admission.justification: Backend side classification and frontend side presentation must agree so a media or binary side cannot hide an independently valid text or absent side.

applicability: Before and after side presentation in the dashboard change-set pane.
conditions: Markdown retains the existing line-diff mode and rendered after-content alternative.
Each side's own text, supported-media, other-binary or absent classification controls its presentation.
exclusions: A rendered comparison between two Markdown documents.
Inventing content for the absent side of an addition or deletion.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §5; dashboard/src/panels/changeset/ChangeSetPane.test.tsx :: offers a 'rendered' toggle for markdown that draws the after-content as prose, not a raw diff; dashboard/src/panels/changeset/ChangeSetPane.test.tsx :: shows a text side beside a binary side instead of calling both binary; mcp/tests/test_serving_media.py::DiffSideTests::test_a_picture_side_names_media_and_a_nul_binary_side_names_binary; mcp/tests/test_serving_media.py::DiffSideTests::test_a_media_side_is_metadata_without_loading_the_blob

statement: The change-set pane keeps Markdown as a line diff with its rendered after-view, and presents media or binary sides separately with an explicit absent-side label.
